verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the voice cloning doc, which lets you give the agent a custom voice (your own, a colleague's, or a voice actor's) so it sounds the way you want. Nothing in the pack shows a broad prebuilt voice library or support for plugging in multiple TTS providers. Missing for 10: broad voice library catalog, multi-TTS-provider/bring-your-own-TTS support, independent corroboration.
